# Node API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_api_docs.py; edit the packaged OpenAPI file. -->

[Download openapi.json](openapi.json) or read the [API quickstart](node-api.md).

API shared by the API-only and GUI launchers. Paths are relative to the server origin. JSON requests use Content-Type: application/json. Protected operations use bearer access tokens; refresh uses a refresh token. File paths refer to files on the node host, not the client. See the user guide for examples and Postman setup.

All request and response schemas below use JSON Schema. `$ref` points to
a named schema in the Shared schemas section. `required` lists mandatory
fields; `allOf` means every listed constraint applies. Examples contain
placeholders to replace with your own paths, identifiers and credentials.

## GET /api/admin/security/logs

Get security logs

Administrator-only audit log search. current_page is zero-based; page_size is clamped to 1–2000. Date filtering defaults to a 5000-entry limit. researcher_id=__none__ selects entries without a researcher. Requires an administrator account.

Authentication: **Bearer access token**.

Parameters:

```json
[
  {
    "name": "page_size",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 200
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "current_page",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "default": 0
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "max_num_of_logs",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Non-positive values disable the explicit limit."
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "operation",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "status",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "researcher_id",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "contains",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "start_ts",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Inclusive timestamp: ISO 8601 or epoch seconds/milliseconds."
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "end_ts",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Inclusive timestamp: ISO 8601 or epoch seconds/milliseconds."
    }
  }
]
```

No request body.

Responses:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful operation. |
| 400 | Invalid input or operation. |
| 401 | Missing, invalid or expired token, or rejected credentials. |

## POST /api/admin/users/create

Create user

Administrator creates a regular user. confirm must equal password. Use change-role separately to grant administrator access. Requires an administrator account. New passwords need at least eight characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.

Authentication: **Bearer access token**.

JSON body (required):

```json
{
  "allOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ValidateUserFormRequest"
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "surname",
        "confirm"
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "password": {
          "minLength": 8,
          "pattern": "^(?=.*?[A-Z])(?=.*?[a-z])(?=.*?[0-9]).{8,}$"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Example:

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.org",
  "password": "ReplaceThis123",
  "confirm": "ReplaceThis123",
  "name": "Example",
  "surname": "User"
}
```

Responses:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Created. |
| 400 | Invalid input or operation. |
| 401 | Missing, invalid or expired token, or rejected credentials. |
| 403 | Administrator permission required. |
| 409 | Conflict with current state. |
| default | Unexpected failure. Framework errors may be non-JSON; inspect HTTP status and response content. |

201 (application/json): [Response](#response).

400 (application/json): [Error](#error).

401 (application/json): [Error](#error).

403 (application/json): [Error](#error).

409 (application/json): [Error](#error).

```json
          "minLength": 8,

      }

  ]
}
```

## GET /api/auth/token/refresh

Refresh expiring jwts

Send the refresh token, not the access token, as Authorization: Bearer <refresh_token>. Returns a new access token and refresh token.

Authentication: **Bearer refresh token**.

No request body.

Responses:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful operation. |
| 401 | JWT validation failed; Flask-JWT-Extended may return {"msg": "..."}. |
| default | Unexpected failure. Framework errors may be non-JSON; inspect HTTP status and response content. |
| 422 | JWT validation failed; Flask-JWT-Extended may return {"msg": "..."}. |

200 (application/json):

```json
{
  "allOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Response"
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "result": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "access_token": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "refresh_token": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "access_token",
            "refresh_token"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "result"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

401 (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object"
}
```

422 (application/json):

```json
{
  "type": "object"
}
```

## POST /api/certificates

Register certificate

Registers a researcher certificate for node–researcher gRPC authentication. certificate is PEM text; component_id is optional when encoded in the certificate. Does not configure HTTPS. Requires an administrator account.

Authentication: **Bearer access token**.

JSON body (required):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "certificate": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "component_id": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "certificate"
  ]
}
```

Responses:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful operation. |
| 400 | Invalid input or operation. |
| 401 | Missing, invalid or expired token, or rejected credentials. |
| 403 | Administrator permission required. |
| 500 | Server or node operation failed. |
| default | Unexpected failure. Framework errors may be non-JSON; inspect HTTP status and response content. |

200 (application/json): [Response](#response).

400 (application/json): [Error](#error).

401 (application/json): [Error](#error).

403 (application/json): [Error](#error).

500 (application/json): [Error](#error).

## POST /api/datasets/add

Add dataset

Registers existing server-side data; does not upload files. type is csv, images, or custom. path is an array of segments relative to --data-folder.

Authentication: **Bearer access token**.

JSON body (required):

```json
{
  "allOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AddDataSetRequest"
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "path": {
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Path segments relative to the server data directory (--data-folder)."
        },
        "tags": {
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Example:

```json
{
  "name": "Example CSV",
  "type": "csv",
  "path": [
    "example.csv"
  ],
  "tags": [
    "#example"
  ],
  "desc": "Example tabular dataset"
}
```

Responses:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful operation. |
| 400 | Invalid input or operation. |
| 401 | Missing, invalid or expired token, or rejected credentials. |
| default | Unexpected failure. Framework errors may be non-JSON; inspect HTTP status and response content. |

200 (application/json):

```json
{
  "allOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Response"
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "result": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Registered dataset ID."
        }
      }

}
```

400 (application/json): [Error](#error).

401 (application/json): [Error](#error).

## POST /api/datasets/add-default-dataset

Add default dataset

Registers MNIST, downloading it if needed. name, tags and desc are required by the handler. Omit path to use defaults/mnist below --data-folder; an explicit path must identify an existing directory.

Authentication: **Bearer access token**.

JSON body (required):

```json
{
  "allOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AddDefaultDatasetRequest"
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "name",
```

## PATCH /api/node/config

Update node config

Read GET /api/node/config first for section names, editable fields and types. Send sections.<section>.values. Optional base_values detects concurrent edits (409); force bypasses that check. A running node may require restarting. Requires an administrator account.

Authentication: **Bearer access token**.

JSON body (required):

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sections": {
      "type": "object",
      "minProperties": 1,
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "values": {
            "type": "object",
            "minProperties": 1,
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "integer",
                "boolean"
              ]
            }
          },
          "base_values": {
            "type": [
              "object",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "Original values for each updated key. Omit to skip conflict detection."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "values"
        ]
      }
    },
    "force": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "sections"
  ]
}
```

Example:

```json
{
  "sections": {
    "default": {
      "values": {
        "name": "My node"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Responses:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful operation. |
| 400 | Invalid input or operation. |
| 401 | Missing, invalid or expired token, or rejected credentials. |
| 403 | Administrator permission required. |
| 409 | Conflict with current state. |
| 500 | Server or node operation failed. |
| default | Unexpected failure. Framework errors may be non-JSON; inspect HTTP status and response content. |

200 (application/json): [Response](#response).

400 (application/json): [Error](#error).

401 (application/json): [Error](#error).

403 (application/json): [Error](#error).

409 (application/json): [Error](#error).

500 (application/json): [Error](#error).

```json
    "required": false,
    "schema": {

      "minimum": 1,
      "default": 100,
      "description": "Values above 2000 are capped."
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "cursor",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "schema": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Byte offset returned as next_cursor."
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "file",
```

## POST /api/update-password

Update password

Changes the authenticated user password. email must match the token and old_password must match the existing password. New passwords need at least eight characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.

Authentication: **Bearer access token**.

JSON body (required):

```json
{
  "allOf": [
    {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ValidateUserFormRequest"
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "old_password"
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "password": {
          "minLength": 8,
          "pattern": "^(?=.*?[A-Z])(?=.*?[a-z])(?=.*?[0-9]).{8,}$"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Example:

```json
{
  "email": "admin@fedbiomed.gui",
  "old_password": "admin",
  "password": "ReplaceThis123"
}
```

Responses:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful operation. |
| 400 | Invalid input or operation. |
| 401 | Missing, invalid or expired token, or rejected credentials. |
| default | Unexpected failure. Framework errors may be non-JSON; inspect HTTP status and response content. |

200 (application/json): [Response](#response).

400 (application/json): [Error](#error).

401 (application/json): [Error](#error).
